voicenote.label: Voice note
voicenote.hint: Medium noise reduction, steadier volume, louder, and silence cut at the start and end. A good first try for most recordings.

podcast.label: Podcast or interview
podcast.hint: Light noise reduction that keeps the voice natural, with steadier volume and louder sound. Pauses are kept as they are.

noisy.label: Noisy room
noisy.hint: Strong noise reduction for a fan, traffic or a busy room. It can make a voice sound a little thinner.

hum.label: Fan or hum
hum.hint: Strong noise reduction and a low rumble filter for a steady buzz from a fan, AC or electrical hum. The volume is not evened out.

louder.label: Just louder
louder.hint: No noise reduction. Evens out the volume and makes a quiet recording louder.
